title: corydalis ambigua f. fumariifolia
intro: Corydalis ambigua f. fumariifolia, commonly known as the Fumitory Corydalis, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family Papaveraceae. It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Central and Eastern Asia, and has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The Fumitory Corydalis is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, and its therapeutic actions include sedation, pain relief, and anti-spasmodic effects.
